title: Fragment of a flattened list
statement: For any type $\beta$, any finite list $xs$ of elements of $\beta$, and any map $G$ assigning a CNF formula over natural-number variables to each element of $\beta$, the binary fragment of the formula obtained by concatenating the formulas $G(b)$ for $b$ in $xs$ is the concatenation, in list order, of the binary fragments of those formulas.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list $xs$ of elements of $\beta$
A map from $\beta$ to CNF formulas over natural-number variables
